newsitem.title: USA: Ashland division forms energy services unit.
newsitem.headline: Ashland division forms energy services unit.

text.p: Ashland Chemical Co, a division of Ashland Inc, said Monday it has formed a unit to provide energy management services to industrial and commercial businesses.

The energy services unit will source and supply natural gas, electricity and natural gas liquids. It will also coordinate purchasing, transmission and distribution, packaging energy choices into a custom-tailored program designed around each customer's particular needs, it said.

"Our goal is to help businesses more easily capture the economic benefits and synergy of today's dynamic, increasingly deregulated but complicated energy marketplace," said David J. D'Antoni, Ashland Chemical's president.
The unit will operate within Ashland Chemical's petrochemical division and will be headed by Sheri Tackett, as director. Tackett was formerly director for natural gas at Ashland Inc.
